      I am never angry with the person that begs of me and I am never sorry for
      having given away a thing!’ And the Brahmana then obtained from the king a
      thousand kine and went away.”

transliteration: upasṛṣṭaṃ tu taṃ kṛṣṇau bhrājamānaṃ dvijottamam / arjuno vāsudevaś ca tūrṇam utpatya tasthatuḥ
